about: Radio Jolene's spoken lines (SND-VOICE, G1626-G1629). tools/audio/prep_voice.js renders each line, plus src/viewer/audio/voice_model.js's VOCAB and one back-announce per track of src/viewer/audio/music_catalogue.json, into media/audio/voice/. 'text' is what the catalogue (and the screen) says; 'say' respells a word for the voice only. A segment's key is how SND-RADIO's data names the recording.

lines.id.1: You're listening to Radio Jolene, ninety point seven, community radio for Jolene Island and the Sound.
lines.id.2: Radio Jolene, ninety point seven. Your island, your station.
lines.id.3: This is ninety point seven, Radio Jolene, keeping the island and the Sound company.
lines.bul.mill: The mill keeps its hours this week, eight to three.
lines.bul.tram: The tram runs every twenty minutes. The last car leaves at six.
lines.bul.ferry: The ferry sails Thursday, weather permitting. Get your freight to the dock by Wednesday noon.
lines.bul.fuel: The fuel dock has diesel and avgas.
lines.bul.potluck: Potluck at the hall, Friday at six. Bring a dish.
lines.bul.coho: The coho are in off the point. Keep the channel clear for the barge.
lines.bul.library: And the library stays open late on Tuesdays.
lines.pil.tamgas: The Tamgas Hill strip is soft after the rain. Land uphill, take off downhill.
lines.pil.seaplane: The seaplane lane is active off the breakwater.
lines.pil.birds: Eagles and gulls at the end of runway one three.
lines.pil.rope: And watch for a tie-down rope across the grass by the club hangar.
lines.swap.outboard: For sale, a fifteen horse outboard. Ask for Ray at the fuel dock.
lines.swap.cub: Wanted, a Cub tailwheel spring. Will trade smoked salmon.
lines.swap.dog: Lost, a brown dog named Biscuit. He answers to his name, and to sandwiches.
lines.swap.stove: And free to a good home, a cast iron stove. You haul it.
lines.wx.intro: Here's the weather at Jolene field.
lines.out.music: More music now, on Radio Jolene.
lines.out.night: That's the news. Stay warm out there.
